e27-schmidt.statement: For every bipartite pure state of qubits, does the sorted computational-basis Schmidt representative minimize the stabilizer 2-Rényi entropy over independent local unitaries?
e27-schmidt.locator: Sierant, Conjecture 1, equations 3–6. Open Quantum Problems E27.
e27-schmidt.implication: A strict increase of normalized Pauli fourth moment on the same local-unitary orbit lowers the stabilizer entropy. One such pair refutes the universal minimum.
e27-schmidt.witness_format: {"sorted":[nonincreasing nonnegative integer amplitudes, length 4,8,16],"left":[i,j,c,s,h],"right":[i,j,c,s,h]}, with distinct ordered indices and c²+s²=h²; or replace both rotations by "permuted": a permutation of sorted.

golay43.statement: Can the logical zero of the 23-qubit quantum Golay code be prepared with at most 43 CNOT gates, on exactly 23 qubits, with free single-qubit Clifford gates, no measurements and no ancillas?
golay43.locator: Ganesan, Appendix A.4, explicit 43-gate challenge; Open Quantum Problems A50
golay43.implication: One allowed signed circuit producing the target logical zero with at most 43 CNOTs proves existence.
golay43.witness_format: {"gates":[["H",0],["CX",0,1],...]} in forward order; H,S,SDG,X,Y,Z,CX allowed on 0..22. The 44-gate source construction is a control.

transport-polygon.statement: For 0 < p ≤ 1 < q, is the polygon bound exact for every finite spectrum and attained by a single exponent-one function of the observable?
transport-polygon.locator: Pitchford, Conjecture 7.7 and Proposition 7.5, release v0.1.0-candidate
transport-polygon.implication: Universal q>1 needs an all-spectrum proof; the current written argument has partial Lean coverage. The separate q=1/2 example lies outside this registered question.
transport-polygon.witness_format: {"steps":[...]} using the bounded Lean tactic grammar supplied with the fixed counting target. A kernel-checked combinatorial lemma is a scoped result.

werner-endpoint.statement: Does there exist a bipartite state with negative partial transpose from which no entanglement can be distilled using any finite number of copies?
werner-endpoint.locator: Open Quantum Problems, Problem 2; distillability criterion and Werner reduction
werner-endpoint.implication: Distillability of one particular state at a finite copy count cannot settle the existence of an NPT state undistillable for every copy count.
werner-endpoint.witness_format: {"copies":4 or 5,"terms":[[left,right],...]}, one or two terms; each local factor is 1–8 [basis,real,imag] integer entries.

gagatsos-2026-c1.statement: For every single-mode state, is the Wigner L1 norm at most the squared integral of sqrt(Q) divided by 8 pi, with equality exactly for coherent states?
gagatsos-2026-c1.locator: Gagatsos, Conjecture 1, Eq. (7), with the conventions in Eqs. (2)-(5)
gagatsos-2026-c1.implication: Finite quadrature can nominate a violating optical state. A rigorous error bound covering the entire phase plane is required to decide the question.
gagatsos-2026-c1.witness_format: {"components":[{"level":0,"real":1,"imag":0},...]}; 3–8 distinct levels 0–24; integer parts of amplitudes −32..32.

refined-bmv.statement: For all finite-dimensional Hermitian H,K and positive integers n,m, is the mean trace of words with n factors exp(H) and m factors exp(K) at least Tr exp(nH+mK)?
refined-bmv.locator: IQOQI problem 40, lower bound. Hägele, arXiv:2611.00129v1, Eq. (1) and Lemmas 2, 5 and 6.
refined-bmv.implication: A strictly negative upper endpoint for the mean word trace minus the exponential trace on a valid pair disproves the lower bound.
refined-bmv.witness_format: {"H":[[integers]],"K":[[integers]],"den":positive integer ≤16,"n":positive integer,"m":positive integer}. Symmetric 2–4 square matrices with common denominator; each row sum of absolute values ≤2 after division; n+m≤12.
